title: This Codex Skill Makes Your AI Images Look Like Real Cinema
description:
Your agent keeps making "beautiful images" that look like loading screens or billboard ads 😅

cinema dna is a skill for Codex that teaches it to think like a director: camera position, who looks at who, and where light comes from. Thats the difference between a movie frame and CG wallpaper ✨

And you get 3 connected shots in 21:9, not one random pic 🔥

#ai #chatgpt #claude #claudecode #gemini
